rationale: The assistant steered to the plinth filter and heat exchanger from the first turn, the customer cleaned both, and the dryer returned to about 2 hours with no warning. Escalation was held back until the warning persisted after cleaning. Minor flaws: it never advised switching off before opening the flap, 'Miele sells replacement plinth filters for the T1' was a mild unsupported fit claim made before the full model was established (conditional on the sponge being damaged), and some cleaning advice was repeated in the later turns.
